runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 13.9.2026 15:39 sweep across 12 actually searched source families. Strongest new fit was Upwork WooCommerce Product Listing & Upload Specialist: worldwide remote, 50–75 products, 10–30 USD/h, WooCommerce/data-entry scope and Dutch only preferred with ChatGPT accepted as fallback. It was not promoted because the listing is already about two weeks old, has 20–50 proposals, one hire and four interviews, so response probability is materially decayed. LinkedIn Wolt support is BA-local but shift-heavy and customer-facing; Pretlak Stretchfit is mid/senior creative; StartupJobs Elasticr remains L2-heavy. Facebook public indexing again produced 0 verified direct hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Stable source-job-ID deduplication
developmentChanges.reason: Extract stable source job identifiers before fuzzy company+title identity so alternate/localized URLs cannot create duplicate LIVE cards.

developmentChanges.title: Dynamic recent-delta fallback
developmentChanges.reason: If a recent-delta manifest is stale or unavailable, derive a bounded fallback rather than silently hiding newly verified records.

developmentChanges.title: Manifest staleness diagnostics
developmentChanges.reason: Separate source-verification age, content age and manifest age so an apparently fresh timestamp cannot hide stale evidence.

developmentChanges.title: Safer normalized identity dedupe
developmentChanges.reason: Normalize common legal-form and title boilerplate before final identity comparison while keeping stable IDs intact.

developmentChanges.title: Structured vs detail language reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: Store both structured and detailed language evidence and rank from the stricter verified requirement.

developmentChanges.title: Temporary-role value-density score
developmentChanges.reason: Score seasonal roles by hourly pay, schedule compatibility, transferable skills and application effort.

developmentChanges.title: Source-family query coverage fingerprint
developmentChanges.reason: Persist actual query themes per source family so repeated runs can detect blind spots.

developmentChanges.title: Candidate evidence-expiry queue
developmentChanges.reason: Prioritize near-expiry high-fit candidates for recheck before evidence becomes stale.

developmentChanges.title: Non-English market hard-gate extractor
developmentChanges.reason: Detect roles whose customer market implies a mandatory foreign language before expensive verification.

developmentChanges.title: Closed-variant sibling suppression
developmentChanges.reason: Cluster role-family siblings so closed variants do not inflate candidate or source-success counts.

developmentChanges.title: Outbound sales burden score
developmentChanges.reason: Separate cold-calling and quota-heavy roles from support/admin work in ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Onboarding location hard-gate
developmentChanges.reason: Track mandatory onboarding location separately from advertised remote mode.

developmentChanges.title: Mandatory certification hard-gate
developmentChanges.reason: Extract legally or operationally mandatory certificates before ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Posting-age vs index-age reconciliation
developmentChanges.reason: Store original published age separately from search-engine crawl age.

developmentChanges.title: Language-band confidence score
developmentChanges.reason: Distinguish ambiguous B1-B2 ranges from explicit B2/C1 requirements and store confidence/evidence.

developmentChanges.title: Remote commute-event frequency gate
developmentChanges.reason: For remote/hybrid roles outside BA, extract frequency of mandatory office/client meetings before ranking.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance client trust gate
developmentChanges.reason: Score client age, spend/hire history, scope specificity and compensation clarity before a freelance listing can enter LIVE.

developmentChanges.title: Application competition decay score
developmentChanges.reason: Use proposal count, client last-viewed time and listing age to deprioritize freelance jobs where response probability has decayed.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance hire-state gate
developmentChanges.reason: Treat existing hires/interviews as a separate conversion-risk signal so excellent-fit gigs are not promoted after the client has likely filled the need.

developmentChanges.title: Preferred-language fallback evidence
developmentChanges.reason: Separate preferred from mandatory language requirements and record whether AI/translation fallback is explicitly accepted, preventing unnecessary rejection of otherwise strong remote e-commerce work.
